Name: LegSoftIK
Description: Creates a utility Soft IK setup for existing biped legs using a DG node network (EM-parallel safe, no expressions).

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Creates a utility Soft IK setup for existing biped legs.
  v002: uses a DG node network instead of a MEL expression — supports EM parallel evaluation and GPU override.

How To Use:
  Build the leg and foot first, then select this block and run Build.

Fields:
- Mirror: build left only, right only, or both sides from the left-side names below.
- LeftAnkleCtrl: IK ankle control used by the leg Soft IK setup.
- LeftSoftIkAttrHolder: node that will receive the SoftIk attr and drive Soft IK amount. Right side is mirrored automatically.
- LeftSoftAttrHolder: deprecated legacy holder for compatibility.
- LeftAnkleRFLGroup: reverse foot ankle group that will own the Soft IK offset groups.
- LeftPelvisCtrl: pelvis or hip control used as the upper distance target.
- LeftIKHandle: ankle IK handle to offset with Soft IK.
- LeftKneeIkJoint: knee IK joint driven through plusMinusAverage.
- LeftStretchAttr: stretch enable attr path connected into the node network.
- LeftPinAttr: pole vector pin attr path connected into the node network.
- GlobalScaleAttr: normalized global size attr path.
- MoverScaleAttr: normalized mover size attr path.

Node network per side (18 nodes, named {L|R}_SoftIK_*_MD/PMA/COND):
  exp() is implemented as e^x via multiplyDivide op=3 (power) — no floatMath required.

Tips:
- Default values assume the standard biped limb and foot naming.
- DistanceDimension nodes are parented under the misc rig group.
- Rebuild after changing any of the paths above.
- Rebuilding deletes and recreates all {L|R}_SoftIK_* nodes automatically.
- Legacy L_SoftIk_Expression / R_SoftIk_Expression are removed on rebuild if present.
